title: What the Worker does not do

entities.title: Signing out does not revoke the token
entities.summary: Sign-out clears the session cookie in this browser and nothing at GitHub.
entities.impact: The token GitHub issued stays valid until the reader revokes the app in their GitHub settings.
entities.workaround: Revoke Cyberspace explorer under Settings → Applications → Authorized OAuth Apps on GitHub.

entities.title: Private repositories need the repo scope
entities.summary: GitHub has no narrower OAuth scope for reading private repositories.
entities.impact: A reader who includes private repositories grants read and write on every private repository they can reach, though the Worker only reads.

entities.title: Sign-in is for GitHub only
entities.summary: There is no sign-in for GitLab.
entities.impact: A GitLab repository is read with a pasted token, or not at all if it is private.

entities.title: A new session secret signs everyone out
entities.summary: Cookies sealed with the old SESSION_SECRET can no longer be opened.
entities.impact: Rotating the secret ends every session and every sign-in under way.
